focus: bridges/planner-orch/brief.py: no absolute workspace path in the brief, the outside check, section-only embedding

summary: context, check, scout and refs read the base of repository paths from Plan.source_root. Without a checkout, check skips the existence of repository paths and warns source_unbound once per plan. context does not report a required repository read missing, and scout is skipped with reason source_unbound. refs takes the own-repository plans next to the plan, and the plans of another repository through the marker of its checkout (store.plans_store_of). brief.py, for a plan outside its checkout, embeds the content of every @plan/ read (only the section for knowledge#section; a non-text file gets error not-text) and the context pack in context_refs. It keeps @plan paths and replaces any absolute workspace path with @workspace. gui-planner raw labels the file <plan-id>/<file>. A plan inside its checkout produces the same brief as before. The code and tests were already in the working tree when the session started; I checked them against the goal and ran the tests, and changed nothing myself.
